#!/bin/sh
IFS= read -r request || exit 0

    header=$(printf '%s' "$header" | tr -d '\r')
    [ -z "$header" ] && break
done
method=${request%% *}
rest=${request#* }
path=${rest%% *}
case "$method:$path" in
    GET:/|GET:/inventory)
        status='200 OK'
        body='{"service":"inventory-api","items":[],"count":0}'
        ;;
    GET:/health)
        status='200 OK'
        body='{"status":"ok","service":"inventory-api"}'
        ;;
    *)
        status='404 Not Found'
        body='{"error":"not found"}'
        ;;
esac
length=${#body}
printf 'HTTP/1.1 %s\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: %s\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n%s' "$status" "$length" "$body"
INVENTORY_HANDLER

chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/batchworker-shell
su batchworker -c 'printf "soft_kib=%s hard_kib=%s user=%s\n" "$(ulimit -S -v)" "$(ulimit -H -v)" "$(id -un)"'

set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- service ---'
rc-service inventory-api status
pid=$(cat /run/inventory-api.pid)
printf 'pid=%s user=%s args=' "$pid" "$(ps -o pid,user | awk -v p="$pid" '$1==p {print $2}')"
tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline"
printf '\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- direct API over node address ---'
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsS "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"; else wget -qO- "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"; fi
printf '\n'
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsS "http://$NODE_IP:8080/inventory"; else wget -qO- "http://$NODE_IP:8080/inventory"; fi
printf '\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- listener ---'
netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':8080 '
